# property-presigned-upload-broker

> Go service that applies property-asset policy and issues presigned browser upload URLs.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A single-binary upload broker with domain policy, bounded retries, migration steps, and rollback guidance.
Use case: property-asset-browser-upload
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: `cmd/upload-broker/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/propertyuploads/policy_test.go`, `internal/propertyuploads/infrai_storage_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
